questions.statement:
"I can't find my passport!"
"You ________ it in your suitcase. You were packing it this morning."

options.feedback: Incorrect. If you were packing, it's very possible you left it there.
Correct! High probability deduction about a past action.
Incorrect. Not for deduction.
Incorrect. This refers to the present.

questions.explanation:
Usamos *must have* seguido del participio pasado para hacer una deducción lógica fuerte sobre algo que ocurrió en el pasado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The first radio broadcast in Colombia ________ in 1929.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice.
Correct! Past Simple Passive for a finished historical event.
Incorrect. Present tense.
Incorrect. Specific past year requires Past Simple.

questions.explanation:
Para hechos históricos donde el objeto (la transmisión) es el foco, usamos el Pasado Simple Pasivo (*was* + participio).

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: If I ________ a world leader, I ________ laws to protect every citizen's digital privacy.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Too unlikely for First Conditional.
Correct! Second Conditional for a hypothetical situation.
Incorrect. Inconsistent tenses.
Incorrect. "Would" doesn't go in the "if" clause.

questions.explanation:
El Segundo Condicional (*were... would*) es el tiempo estándar para hablar de sueños o situaciones imaginarias en el presente.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Direct Speech: "Where did you buy that traditional hat?"
Reported Speech: He asked me where I ________ that traditional hat.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Missing backshift.
Correct! Past Simple shifts to Past Perfect in Reported Speech.
Incorrect. Auxiliaries are not used in reported questions.
Incorrect. Inappropriate tense shift.

questions.explanation:
Al reportar una pregunta en pasado, el verbo retrocede al Pasado Perfecto (*had bought*) y el orden vuelve a ser el de una afirmación.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: He ________ the manager. He is too young and he doesn't know how the system works.
questions.context: Reviewing modal deductions with negative evidence.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Mustn't" is for prohibition.
Correct! Strong negative deduction based on evidence.
Incorrect. This is for less certain possibility.
Incorrect. Refers to the past.

questions.explanation:
Usamos *can't* cuando estamos seguros de que algo no es posible en el presente basándonos en evidencias o lógica.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: All historical sites ________ by visitors to ensure their preservation for future generations.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice.
Correct! Modal Passive (modal + be + past participle).
Incorrect. Missing "be".
Incorrect. Grammatically incorrect.

questions.explanation:
La voz pasiva con modales es esencial para expresar reglas, obligaciones o consejos de manera formal y general.

questions.subject: ingles

options.text: If we raise awareness, more people will join our cause.
options.feedback: Correct! First conditional is for real/likely future events.

options.text: If we raised awareness, more people would join our cause.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This implies we are not currently raising awareness.

options.text: If we had raised awareness, more people would have joined.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This refers to a past regret.

options.text: We will raise awareness unless more people join.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This logic doesn't make sense in this context.

questions.explanation:
A nivel B2, el estudiante debe diferenciar el grado de probabilidad entre el Primer Condicional (real) y el Segundo (hipotético).

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The activist ________ to support the new law.
questions.context: Reporting a request vs. a question.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Mixed direct and indirect speech.
Correct! "Urge" is a reporting verb for strong requests, followed by object + to + infinitive.
Incorrect. "Say" cannot be used with an object + infinitive.
Incorrect. Missing object and proper structure.

questions.explanation:
Existen diversos verbos de reporte (*urge*, *advise*, *encourage*) que siguen la estructura de peticiones/órdenes: objeto + *to* + infinitivo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The ancient builders ________ very advanced tools, though we haven't found them yet.
questions.context: Complex deduction about a historical figure.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Present deduction.
Correct! Deduction about the past based on the results (the buildings).
Incorrect. Contradicts the achievement.
Incorrect. This is for unfulfilled obligations.

questions.explanation:
Para explicar logros del pasado cuya metodología exacta desconocemos, el *must have* permite proponer la explicación más lógica.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Identify the error in this paragraph:
"Social media **is used** (A) by billions. Experts say that if we **would spend** (B) less time online, we **would be** (C) happier. They also told us **to find** (D) more offline hobbies."
questions.context: Identifying an error in a summary of cultural trends.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Correct Present Passive.
Correct! In the "if" clause of a conditional, we use past simple (*spent*), not *would*.
Incorrect. Correct use of *would* in the result clause.
Incorrect. Correct reported request structure.

questions.explanation:
Recordar que nunca se coloca *would* inmediatamente después de *if* es una de las reglas de oro de los condicionales en el nivel B2.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which of these reported questions sounds the most **polite and formal**?
questions.context: Judging the most polite reported question.

options.text: He asked what was my name.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Incorrect word order for reported speech.

options.text: He inquired whether I was interested in the position.
options.feedback: Correct! "Inquire" and "whether" are more formal than "ask" and "if".

options.text: He asked if I liked the job.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This is correct but less formal than B.

options.text: He wanted to know why did I come.
options.feedback: Incorrect. "Did" should not be in a reported question.

questions.explanation:
El uso de verbos de reporte más sofisticados (*inquire*) y el conector *whether* eleva el registro del lenguaje, algo esperado en estudiantes de nivel B2.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Choose the most coherent summary:
"If cultures ________ more, stereotypes ________. That's why the teacher ________ us to learn about other traditions."
questions.context: Choosing the best integration of multiple structures.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Mixed conditional and poor reporting.
Correct! Second conditional for a desired state and proper reporting verb.
Incorrect. Third conditional doesn't fit the general advice.
Incorrect. Zero conditional is too simplistic here.

questions.explanation: Este ejercicio final integra el pensamiento hipotético (*Second Conditional*) con el reporte de una recomendación (*Reported Request*) en un contexto cultural.
